data.long_meaning: Marjanah is an Arabic name derived from the word 'marjana' which means 'gem' or 'precious stone'. In the Islamic context, it can symbolize a valuable treasure, a precious soul, or a radiant, beautiful being. The name Marjanah carries the meaning “Gem of the Sea” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Marjanah usually hope their child will grow to embody gem of the sea and live with faith, good character and purpose.
